name: Lyric Miniplayer
description: A floating Picture-in-Picture lyrics window that stays on top of other apps. Includes syllable karaoke wipe animation, customizable lyric providers (Auto/Spotify/LRCLIB), window size memory, background opacity slider, Ctrl+Scroll font zooming, Japanese & Korean Romanization (Romaji / Furigana / Romaja), Lyrics Only mode, Dynamic theme, and playback controls.
